# Universal Life Church

> The Universal Life Church (ULC) is a non-denominational church that has ordained more than 20 million people online, free of charge. Ordination is permanent and is recognized for officiating weddings across the United States; some states and counties require registration or proof of ordination.

## Ordination
- [Get ordained online](https://www.ulc.org/get-ordained): free two-step application
- [How to get ordained online](https://www.ulc.org/training/ordination-training): steps, cost, timing, legality
- [About the ULC](https://www.ulc.org/about): beliefs (two tenets), legitimacy, contact

## Officiating weddings
- [How to officiate a wedding](https://www.ulc.org/officiate-a-wedding): four-step guide and state picker
- [Texas officiant requirements](https://www.ulc.org/officiate-a-wedding/texas): example state guide (registration, witnesses, license deadlines)

## Minister Store
- [Minister Store](https://www.ulc.org/minister-store): credentials, wedding sets, certificates
- [Classic Wedding Set](https://www.ulc.org/minister-store/classic-wedding-set): most popular officiant kit
